item.title: Docs: UX survey construction framing (flow, stable IDs, contracts between lots)
item.body:
## Issue
Refs #628 (umbrella of the UX survey; the lots #629 to #635 deliver the survey itself)
Direct-PR: maintainer's own framing doc, no lot

## What and why
Adds `docs/ux/questionnaire/cadrage-construction.md` (French): the framing for building the survey, complementing the per-lot briefs of `docs/ux/cadrage-agents-questionnaire.md`. The issues stay the source of truth.

It adds what the briefs lack:
- the flow screen by screen, with a stable ID per question (`E0`, `P1`–`P3`, `O1`, `L1`–`L2`, `D1`–`D2`, `C01`–`C11`, `M1`, `F1`, `I1`, `E1`) and a time budget;
- contracts between lots: stable answer codes, a fixed block format for `questions.md` checked by a test against the form's content file, naming and size rules for visuals;
- constraints for the form spec (#633): no third-party requests, accessible card sort, single submission, threshold before live stats, closing date and removal;
- theme 1: capture SwiftHFR where an improvement already exists instead of drawing mock-ups (#632);
- six PO decisions still open (D1–D6), none blocking wave 1;
- known gaps between the archive and the issues, and three follow-up lots without an issue (trial, opening, analysis), to create only with the PO's agreement.

`docs/ux/README.md` gets a one-line pointer to it.

This is a framing document, not a decision to implement: it changes neither `LOTS.md` nor `FEATURES.md`.

## How it was verified
- `markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1` with the repository config: 0 errors.
- Content checked against `docs/ux/tri-m5-decisions.md` §4, `docs/ux/plan-preparation-questionnaire.md` §2 and the bodies of #628 to #635.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Module boundaries respected (docs only)
- [x] Tests added/updated: not applicable, docs only
- [x] No secrets; fixtures anonymized
- [x] Docs updated
- [x] Author model: Opus 5.5 / Reviewer: the PO
- [x] Fixes or changes a legacy-app behaviour? No

+

+- dans le modèle de données de la spécification (#633) ;
+- dans le fichier de contenu et l'export du formulaire (#634) ;
+- dans l'analyse des résultats.
+
+Chaque réponse possible porte aussi un code stable, en minuscules ASCII, par exemple `iphone`, `ipad`, `duo`, `plusieurs` pour `P1`. La rédaction choisit les codes, la spécification les reprend. Changer un identifiant ou un code après la vague 1 demande de modifier ce document.
+
+### 3.2 Forme de `questions.md`
+
+Un bloc par identifiant, toujours dans le même ordre :
+
+```markdown

+- Section du tri : §4.1
+- Question : Sur quel appareil utilisez-vous surtout l'app ?
+- Réponses : `iphone` iPhone · `ipad` iPad · `duo` iPhone Duo · `plusieurs` Plusieurs
+- Aide : (facultative)
+- Condition : (aucune)

+
